rule.name: SingularAndPluralMember
rule.message: A member and its plural (tag and tags) are two ways to pass the same data. Keep the plural and pass one item as a one-element list.

property.name: xpath
property.value: let $boxes := map { 'boolean': 'Boolean', 'byte': 'Byte', 'char': 'Character', 'short': 'Short', 'int': 'Integer', 'long': 'Long', 'float': 'Float', 'double': 'Double' }, $irregular := ('analysis:analyses', 'axis:axes', 'child:children', 'criterion:criteria', 'foot:feet', 'index:indices', 'index:indexes', 'leaf:leaves', 'life:lives', 'man:men', 'matrix:matrices', 'mouse:mice', 'person:people', 'tooth:teeth', 'vertex:vertices', 'woman:women'), $upper := function($word) { upper-case(substring($word, 1, 1)) || substring($word, 2) }, $plurals := function($name) { ($name || 's', $name || 'es', if (matches($name, '[^aeiou]y$')) then substring($name, 1, string-length($name) - 1) || 'ies' else (), for $pair in $irregular return let $one := substring-before($pair, ':'), $many := substring-after($pair, ':') return if ($name = $one) then $many else if (ends-with($name, $upper($one))) then substring($name, 1, string-length($name) - string-length($one)) || $upper($many) else ()) }, $nullable := function($member) { exists($member/ModifierList/Annotation[@SimpleName = 'Nullable']) }, $entity := function($class) { exists($class/ModifierList/Annotation[ pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.persistence.Entity') or pmd-java:typeIs('javax.persistence.Entity') or pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.persistence.Embeddable') or pmd-java:typeIs('javax.persistence.Embeddable') or pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.persistence.MappedSuperclass') or pmd-java:typeIs('javax.persistence.MappedSuperclass')]) }, $component := function($class) { exists($class/ModifierList/Annotation[ pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.stereotype.Component') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.stereotype.Service') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.stereotype.Repository') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.stereotype.Controller') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration')]) }, $dto := function($class) { not($entity($class)) and not($component($class)) and ( exists($class/ModifierList/Annotation[ pmd-java:typeIs('lombok.Value') or pmd-java:typeIs('lombok.Data') or pmd-java:typeIs('lombok.Builder') or pmd-java:typeIs('lombok.experimental.SuperBuilder') or pmd-java:typeIs('lombok.extern.jackson.Jacksonized')]) or exists(($class/ModifierList/Annotation | $class/ClassBody/FieldDeclaration/ModifierList/Annotation | $class/ClassBody/ConstructorDeclaration/ModifierList/Annotation) [ClassType[starts-with(@SimpleName, 'Json')]] [pmd-java:typeIs('com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonProperty') or pmd-java:typeIs('com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonAlias') or pmd-java:typeIs('com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonCreator') or pmd-java:typeIs('com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonInclude') or pmd-java:typeIs('com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonFormat') or pmd-java:typeIs('com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonIgnoreProperties') or pmd-java:typeIs('com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonPropertyOrder') or pmd-java:typeIs('com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonTypeName') or pmd-java:typeIs('com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.annotation.JsonDeserialize') or pmd-java:typeIs('com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.annotation.JsonSerialize') or pmd-java:typeIs('com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.annotation.JsonNaming')]) or (exists($class/ClassBody/MethodDeclaration) and (every $method in $class/ClassBody/MethodDeclaration satisfies matches($method/@Name, '^(get|set|is)[A-Z]') or $method/@Name = ('equals', 'hashCode', 'toString')))) }, $exported := function($executable) { $executable/(self::MethodDeclaration | self::ConstructorDeclaration)[pmd-java:modifiers() = 'public'] [not(ModifierList/Annotation[pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.Override')])] [not(self::ConstructorDeclaration and parent::RecordBody)] [ancestor::*[self::ClassDeclaration or self::InterfaceDeclaration or self::EnumDeclaration or self::RecordDeclaration][1][pmd-java:modifiers() = 'public']] }, $typeOf := function($member) { ($member/ClassType | $member/ArrayType | $member/PrimitiveType)[1] }, $nameOf := function($member) { ($member/VariableId | $member/VariableDeclarator/VariableId)[1]/@Name }, $simple := function($type) { if ($type[self::PrimitiveType]) then $boxes($type/@Kind) else $type/@SimpleName } return ( //RecordDeclaration/RecordComponentList/RecordComponent[not(@Varargs = true())] | //ClassDeclaration[ancestor-or-self::ClassDeclaration/ModifierList/Annotation [pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.boot.context.properties.ConfigurationProperties')] or $dto(.)] /ClassBody/FieldDeclaration[not(pmd-java:modifiers() = 'static')] | //FormalParameters[exists($exported(..))]/FormalParameter[not(@Varargs = true())][$nullable(.)] ) [let $type := $typeOf(.), $element := if ($type[self::ArrayType]) then $type/*[1] else $type[self::ClassType][@SimpleName = ('List', 'Set', 'Collection', 'Iterable', 'SortedSet')] /TypeArguments[count(*) = 1]/*[1], $plural := $nameOf(.) return exists($element) and (some $other in ../(RecordComponent | FieldDeclaration[not(pmd-java:modifiers() = 'static')] | FormalParameter[not(@Varargs = true())][$nullable(.)]) satisfies let $own := $typeOf($other) return $plural = $plurals($nameOf($other)) and $own[self::ClassType or self::PrimitiveType] and $simple($own) = $simple($element) and not($own/TypeArguments) and not($element/TypeArguments))]
